# BookOdds

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Stats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class BookOdds
```

One CookBook, resolved down to what pricing an asset against it needs. Build one with [`SelectionOdds.Prepare()`](Nfty.Core.Stats.SelectionOdds.md#m-prepare-nfty-core-formats-peekedcookbook-system-int64); see [`SelectionOdds`](Nfty.Core.Stats.SelectionOdds.md) for the arithmetic.

## Remarks

Immutable once built and safe to share: nothing here is written after the constructor, so a front-end may prepare one off the UI thread and price from it on any other.

The chance of rolling the selection one cooked asset carries.

**Parameters**

- `item` (`SetItem`) - The asset, as its metadata records it.

**Returns.** Its chance, or [`SelectionChance.Nothing`](Nfty.Core.Stats.SelectionChance.md#p-nothing) when the asset cannot be mapped onto this book.

### Of(string, IReadOnlyDictionary&lt;string, string&gt;, IReadOnlyCollection&lt;string&gt;) { #m-of-system-string-system-collections-generic-ireadonlyd-22ef9e }

```csharp
public SelectionChance Of(string recipeId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> traits, IReadOnlyCollection<string> absentLayers);
```

The chance of rolling a selection, named the way a Set's metadata names one.

**Parameters**

- `recipeId` (`string`) - The recipe's **id** — what `nfty/NNNN.json` records.
- `traits` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>`) - Variant NAME per layer NAME, for the layers that are present. Names rather than ids because names are all a Set records; a layer carrying two variants of one name is scored as either of them, which is the event the metadata actually describes.
- `absentLayers` (`IReadOnlyCollection<string>`) - The layer names this selection leaves out entirely.

**Returns.** Its chance, or [`SelectionChance.Nothing`](Nfty.Core.Stats.SelectionChance.md#p-nothing) when the selection cannot be mapped onto this book.
